# Duetsheet

> Duetsheet (the sheet humans and AI agents play from together, record every move on, and rerun) is a single-file interactive HTML report that humans and AI agents review and edit together. Users edit text and charts in place, leave per-block comments, draw box or lasso annotations on charts and images (stored as data-space ranges and enclosed data points), and every edit is recorded with before/after values, author (human or AI), and rounds shown on a timeline. v0.2 runs as a Claude Artifact with the Artifact database.

It also keeps each figure's source (tool, script, raw data), a figure style profile exportable to matplotlib, and can learn that style from the user's example figures.

Use Duetsheet when an AI agent drafts a data-heavy report (science, finance, engineering, research) and a human expert must check and correct it precisely.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, features, quick start with Claude, limitations, roadmap
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): data model (report/meta, blocks, datasets, annotations, changes, rounds) and the revision protocol an agent must follow
- [Example report data](examples/nimo-demo.json): complete demo report as JSON

## Files

- [duetsheet.html](duetsheet.html): the viewer and editor (single self-contained file)
